text:
dana: FYI we got a PM escalation: tenants are confused by v1 deprecation banners + unexpected quota deltas. they see 'estimated monthly spend' change even when traffic didn't.

kevin: is this the same thing where the console shows per-version projected cost but the billing pipeline attributes by final_served_route? mismatch.

mei: yep. console projection uses route-based sizing (assumes client will hit v2), billing uses request attribution which picks up fallbacks. results differ.

dana: ops report shows these cases usually happen when tenant uses pinning + canary routing. small percent but high impact for invoices.

kevin: quick ask: can we make the console show both numbers side-by-side: "Console estimate (route-based)" vs "Billing projection (attribution-based)"? helps transparency.

mei: UI doable but need a stable field from backend: add `proj_mode` to the pricing API: values {route, attribution}.

ops-bot: incident-note: customer ticket #30421 linked. created autotag: billing-impact.

product-gw: copy idea: "Two cost estimates: Runtime Routing (what we expect will run) vs Billing Attribution (how tokens are billed). Learn more -> link." keep short.

finance: if we expose both, finance wants a short explainer about how to reconcile month-end numbers. we'll need docs and a sample CSV export showing mapping.

dana: tech options brainstorm: A) change billing to use route-based projection (big risk) B) keep billing and make console aware (low risk) C) change routing to emit canonical attribution IDs and backfill (medium).

kevin: B is fastest and lowest risk. C is longer term and preferred for correctness. A is off the table.

mei: implementation sketch for B: pricing API calls model service + routing preview with `proj_mode=route` and ETL exposes `billing_mode=attribution`. console requests both and shows diff. small perf hit.

kevin: also add a one-off telemetry tag when deprecation banners are shown: `deprecation_banner_shown=true` so we can slice affected tenants for finance.

product-gw: banner copy draft: "v1 deprecated — we'll route new traffic to v2. Pinned versions and fallbacks may still incur v1 charges. Click to see how this affects your estimates." short link to doc.

finance: can we get a list of tenants with >500k tokens/mo who saw >7% diff between the two modes in the last 7 days? we'll triage.

ops-bot: query queued: cost-delta-scan for 7d window. results ETA 2h.

dana: rollout plan: 1) implement `proj_mode` endpoint + console UI (canary) 2) emit banner telemetry 3) surface a banner "cost variance possible" for tenants with >threshold 4) follow-up engineering work on attribution IDs.

mei: PR checklist: pricing API feature flag `console_proj_modes` default=false, unit tests for both modes, perf test for pricing latency, audit log for requests.

kevin: snippet for feature flag config: ```yaml
flags:
  console_proj_modes:
    enabled: false
    rollout: 10%
    buckets: org_id
```

product-gw: tooltip text draft for UI hover: "Why two estimates? Routing-based shows expected runtime. Attribution-based shows historical billing signals. Differences can occur when pinned versions or fallbacks are used." keep friendly.

finance: after canary, send list to finance@redwood with sample tenant CSV. need to sign off before full rollout.

dana: owners: mei -> API + telemetry tags, kevin -> backend routing/product mapping + perf, product-gw -> console copy + tooltip, finance -> reconciliation and list, dana -> coord + docs. reconvene after ops-bot query. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: cost-delta-scan completed. 12 tenants >500k tokens with >7% diff. report uploaded to /reports/cost-delta-1788888888.csv

kevin: grabbing report. will prioritize 3 tenants with live contracts.

mei: starting feature-flagged PR. estimate 1 day for server, 2 days for console.

product-gw: I'll wire the tooltip and the banner variant to only show for orgs in the uploaded report.

dana: good. and add a support canned response for CS: "We're rolling out improved cost projections to help reconcile billing vs runtime. See <link> or open support ticket and we'll review your account."

finance: noted. will prepare a reconciliation template.

kevin: small follow-up: add a smoke test for projected vs billed diff not >50% during canary. if breached, auto-disable flag.

mei: added to PR. will post canary metrics here once ready.

dana: thanks team. keeping this thread as the source of truth for rollout.
